about: MROUND, CEILING.MATH and FLOOR.MATH beyond Windows Excel's observations in ExcelCases' mround, ceiling-math and floor-math (ADR-0047): what is refused rather than given a tolerance Excel was not seen to use. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' ObservedRoundingTests.

cases.name: ADR-0047: division at an unobserved integer boundary does not invent a tolerance: =FLOOR.MATH(0.3,0.1)
ADR-0047: division at an unobserved integer boundary does not invent a tolerance: =CEILING.MATH(0.07,0.01)
ADR-0047: a nonzero quotient that underflows is not a known zero: =CEILING.MATH(1E-300,1E300)
ADR-0047: a nonzero quotient that underflows is not a known zero: =FLOOR.MATH(-1E-300,1E300)
ADR-0047: documented integer multiples and default significance: =MROUND(10,3)
ADR-0047: documented integer multiples and default significance: =MROUND(-10,-3)
ADR-0047: documented integer multiples and default significance: =MROUND(17,5)
ADR-0047: documented integer multiples and default significance: =MROUND(18,5)
ADR-0047: documented integer multiples and default significance: =MROUND(0,-5)
ADR-0047: documented integer multiples and default significance: =CEILING.MATH(2.5)
ADR-0047: documented integer multiples and default significance: =FLOOR.MATH(2.5)
ADR-0047: MROUND refuses fractional multiples: =MROUND(1.3,0.2)
ADR-0047: MROUND refuses fractional multiples: =MROUND(-1.3,-0.2)
ADR-0047: rounding that overflows is an Error Value: =MROUND(1.7E307*10,1E307*10)
ADR-0047: rounding that overflows is an Error Value: =CEILING.MATH(1.7E307*10,1E307*10)
ADR-0047: rounding that overflows is an Error Value: =FLOOR.MATH(-1.7E307*10,1E307*10)
ADR-0047: MROUND rejects boolean arguments, References to them included: =MROUND(2.5,TRUE)
ADR-0047: MROUND rejects boolean arguments, References to them included: =MROUND(A1,1)
ADR-0047: rounding recalculates when the multiple changes
ADR-0047: MROUND rounds to an integer multiple away from zero at halfway
ADR-0047: FLOOR.MATH uses the observed negative number mode
ADR-0047: CEILING.MATH uses the observed negative number mode
